Exchanges.Text: Good morning, Payments (Demo) team. Our sprint goal is "Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically," and there are 6 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, quick check-in: is story 3 done, is story 4 done, and is task 15 done?
Also, what did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: yesterday you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests, and nothing is blocking you.

For story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, it has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Daniel, for the summary page being blocked until the idempotency keys are in, who can help unblock this?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.
Daniel, task 15, Add structured logging to gateway client, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Structured logging is nearly done. I'll finish it today.

Thanks, Daniel. Maya, are story 5 and bug 12 done, and what did you finish?
What’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline and I will add it to the parking lot, Maya please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for the blocker on bug 12 with the sandbox gateway timing out and needing access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.
For story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker and your commitment, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya. Admin, about task 14, is it done after your earlier commitment to finish it tomorrow?
What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted your update.

Task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Admin, for the task 14 delay caused by the sandbox being down, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll sync with her after the stand-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers raised include the summary page waiting on idempotency keys, bug 12 with sandbox gateway timeouts and staging access, PCI scan exceptions waiting on security review, and work delayed when the sandbox was down.
A side discussion about gateway timeouts and configuration was parked for offline.
Task 19 is stale and at risk, and its owners will get a follow-up.
Follow-ups, including for anyone absent or who did not respond, are coming in Teams, and thank you all.
